questions.text: A beam that is fixed at one end and free at the other is called a:

rationale.a: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.c: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.d: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.correct: A cantilever beam is fixed at one end (providing three reactions: Hx, Hy, M) and extends freely beyond the fixed support without additional support at the free end.
rationale.takeaway: Review the correct answer and associated code provision.

questions.text: A cantilever balcony slab extends 2.5 m from a building wall. The slab is fixed to the building structure at the wall. In this configuration, where is the maximum bending moment located?

options.text: At the free end of the balcony
At midspan between the wall and free end
Bending moment is constant throughout the balcony

rationale.a: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.c: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.d: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.correct: In a cantilever, the maximum bending moment occurs at the fixed end (the wall connection). This is where the largest moment reaction develops to resist the cantilevered loads.
rationale.takeaway: Review the correct answer and associated code provision.

questions.text: Which beam type develops a moment reaction at the support(s)?

options.text: Overhanging beam with hinges at supports

rationale.a: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.c: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.d: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.correct: Only the cantilever beam, which is fixed at one end, develops a moment reaction (M) at the support. The fixed-end condition prevents rotation and thus generates a resisting moment.
rationale.takeaway: Review the correct answer and associated code provision.

questions.text: A roof canopy extends 4 m beyond its supporting columns. The canopy is supported by two columns with the roof extending past both. This configuration is best classified as a:

rationale.a: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.b: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.d: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.correct: An overhanging beam has two or more supports with one or both ends extending beyond the supports. A canopy with two supporting columns and a 4 m overhang beyond the columns fits this definition.
rationale.takeaway: Review the correct answer and associated code provision.

questions.text: A simply supported beam is characterized by which of the following?

options.text: Fixed at one end; free at the other, allowing for rotational movement
Supported on two hinges (or hinge + roller) at the ends; no overhang
Supported on three or more points spanning multiple bays, providing additional stability
Supported with one end extending beyond the supports, creating a cantilever effect

rationale.a: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.c: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.d: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.correct: A simply supported beam (simple beam) rests on two supports—typically a hinge at one end and a roller at the other, or hinges at both ends—with no overhang. Loads are transmitted directly to the two end supports.
rationale.takeaway: Review the correct answer and associated code provision.

questions.text: In a continuous beam spanning multiple bays, where do negative moments (hogging moments) typically occur?

options.text: Negative moments do not occur in continuous beams

rationale.a: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.c: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.d: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.correct: In a continuous beam, negative moments (hogging, tension on the top) develop over intermediate supports. This is a key difference from simply supported beams, which develop only positive moments at midspan.
rationale.takeaway: Review the correct answer and associated code provision.

questions.text: An engineer is comparing three beam configurations: (1) a 10 m simple beam, (2) a 5 m cantilever, and (3) a 5 m overhanging beam with a 2.5 m overhang on each side. All carry the same uniform load. Which beam will experience the largest deflection at its free or overhang end?

options.text: Deflection cannot be compared without knowing the load magnitude

rationale.a: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.c: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.d: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.correct: The cantilever experiences the largest deflection because fixed supports resist rotation very stiffly, but the cantilevered portion has no intermediate support and experiences the full moment effect over its length. Among the three, the 5 m cantilever's deflection rate is steepest.
rationale.takeaway: Review the correct answer and associated code provision.

questions.text: A propped cantilever is a structural configuration that combines characteristics of which two beam types?

options.text: Simply supported and continuous, providing a balance between flexibility and support
Overhanging and fixed, offering stability with extended reach
Continuous and overhanging, allowing for extended spans with intermediate supports

rationale.a: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.c: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.d: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.correct: A propped cantilever is a cantilever beam with an additional support (prop) at or near the free end. It combines the cantilever's fixed end with an intermediate support that reduces deflection compared to a pure cantilever.
rationale.takeaway: Review the correct answer and associated code provision.

questions.text: A multi-story building frame has floor beams that span across multiple columns and develop both positive moments at midspan and negative moments over interior columns. The frame also has exterior walls that cantilever outward for architectural effect. Which statement best describes the overall frame structure and its components?

options.text: All floor beams are simply supported; exterior walls are continuous, which is a simplification that does not account for the structural dynamics
Floor beams are continuous across multiple supports; exterior walls are cantilever
All beams are cantilever; the frame is overhanging, which is an incorrect description of the structural system
The frame is simply supported; no negative moments occur, which overlooks the complexity of the structural behavior

rationale.a: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.c: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.d: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.correct: Floor beams spanning across multiple columns are continuous beams, which develop both positive moments (at midspan) and negative moments (over intermediate supports). Cantilevering exterior walls are cantilever beams, which develop moment reactions at the fixed connection to the building.
rationale.takeaway: Review the correct answer and associated code provision.

questions.text: A continuous beam spans across four columns, creating three interior spans. This beam type is called:

rationale.a: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.b: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.d: This option is incorrect. Review the correct answer above.
rationale.correct: A continuous beam spans across three or more supports, creating multiple spans. Four columns provide four supports (creating three spans between them); this is the definition of continuous.
rationale.takeaway: Review the correct answer and associated code provision.
